@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: 'SK-7c: Remove the temporary default `mode: ToolMode = .open` after ACPAgent passes the mode'
+---
+## What
+SK-7a (6c5d30d) made `mode: ToolMode` required. FoundationModelsACPAgent `main` did not pass a mode yet, and TestudoApp CI resolves branch `main` of each package, thus each clean build broke. testudoapp-75 asked for a temporary default `mode: ToolMode = .open` (the hotfix commit of this task's comments). The `ToolMode.validate(probe:)` check of Extras still refuses `open` in a sandboxed process, thus the default is safe for now.
+
+EXTERNAL DEPENDENCY: ACPAgent task ^bwgmkc0 (ACPA-19d, session foundationmodelsacpagent-ec) must be pushed first. It passes the same mode to `SkillsRegistry` and `SkillsToolContext`. Do not start before foundationmodelsacpagent-ec sends that commit.
+
+Change (no backward compatibility, ARCHITECTURE.md):
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillsRegistry.swift`: remove `= .open` from the four public inits `init(roots:mode:...)`, `init(stack:mode:...)`, `init(layers:mode:...)`, `init(marketplaces:stack:mode:...)`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Operations/SkillsToolContext.swift`: remove `= .open` from `init(registry:searchAgent:mode:...)`.
+- Remove the doc-comment text that tells about the temporary default.
+- Change each caller in this package that relies on the default.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No public init of `SkillsRegistry` or `SkillsToolContext` has a default value for `mode`.
+- [ ] `git grep -n 'mode: ToolMode = ' Sources` gives nothing.
+- [ ] FoundationModelsACPAgent `main` builds against this commit (its ^bwgmkc0 is pushed).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsSkillsTests/SandboxedModeTests.swift`: add a source-scan test (use `SwiftSourceScan`) that no line under `Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/` has `mode: ToolMode = `.
+- [ ] `swift test` passes with no warnings.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #step1 #needs-acpagent-bwgmkc0
\ No newline at end of file
